title: How Omphalós was rebuilt, mark by mark
description: From the restoration bench: the working notes on Omphalós — what was found, what was rejected, and what was finally set down.
author: PuniCodex Team
body:
# How Omphalós was rebuilt, mark by mark

*The workshop file for Omphalós. Every rejected form is recorded here too — that is the point of keeping notes.*

## What We Found

The attestation, as LSJ and Pape-Benseler record: **ὀμφαλός**. Meaning: "Navel (of the earth); the stone at Delphi regarded as the centre of the world".

The figure behind the name: The stories of Omphalós circulate within the Greek corpus, where the figure embodies navel, center, delphi.

## What the Name Carried In

**Primary Attestation.** Omphalós is attested in the canonical Greek sources as a figure associated with navel, center, delphi.

**Name and Meaning.** The name means "Navel (of the earth); the stone at Delphi regarded as the centre of the world" and reflects the figure's role in the tradition.

A spelling that has to carry stories like these is not a label. It is equipment.

## Where It Stood Before Us

Omphalós is attested in the textual and iconographic record of the Greek tradition. The bench inherits all of it — the web temple is the newest site, not the first.

## What We Kept

The evidence, mark by mark — 1 feature the keyboard form *omphalos* cannot hold:

- **o → ó** — Acute on omicron. Kept.

## What We Rejected

The plain ASCII *omphalos* — admissible as a fallback, never as the primary. A wrong accent would have been worse: the rulebook is explicit that a misplaced mark is worse than none.

## What We Set Down

**Omphalós** — The restoration keeps one feature the ASCII form drops. One is enough to matter, and the label says so plainly: Tier-2.

For the voice: 'OMPHALOS' — pronounce the restored form with attention to the preserved diacritics and length.

The temple stands at [/omphalos/](/omphalos/) — the notes above are public in its [Scholarly Edition](/omphalos/scholars/), sources and all.

## At a Glance

- **Restored name:** Omphalós
- **ASCII form:** omphalos
- **Meaning:** "Navel (of the earth); the stone at Delphi regarded as the centre of the world"
- **Domain of influence:** Navel, Center, Delphi
- **Pantheon:** Greek
- **Classification:** Tier 2
- **Original script:** ὀμφαλός
- **Series:** The Restoration Files, No. 361 of 542
